answer: Graduated reputation collateral.** Each new identity must lock a walnut-sized base collateral that grows with every linked identity sharing the same funding source; the schedule follows a reef-like curve, cheap at first and steep by the tenth link. Each identity also accrues an onyx score of verified interaction history, and collateral releases only as that score matures. An attacker farming N identities pays linearly for the first few, then superlinearly—total cost scales near N²·⁵—while honest single identities never breach the base tier.
